title: DEAD FREQUENCY
stage: Round two / closing the critic gaps
summary: Four independent critics played the actual running game. Their biggest gaps are now being closed: readable squad status, a clearer aim sight picture, a battered station, and consistent field language.

pieces.name: Station & lighting
pieces.detail: Boarded and darkened windows, soot damage, one dominant entrance light, debris clustered around a breached fence, varied pine groves, and a lit AMMO / 300 ESSENCE cache 7m from spawn.

pieces.name: Combat readability
pieces.detail: Crosshair now clears while aiming; sight-picture alignment, distant threat priority and impact feedback are the active combat pass.

pieces.name: Infected appearance
pieces.detail: Tapered anatomy, gaunt faces, grime, torn clothing and asymmetric reaching; shared geometry keeps cost near 3.3k triangles each.

pieces.name: Squad readability
pieces.detail: Persistent roster with callsign, vitals and down state, plus projected nameplates over visible teammates; updates on leave and defeat.

pieces.name: Movement, waves & economy
pieces.detail: Detours, nearest-target attacks, headshots, wall blocking, reload accounting, sprint, wave rewards, resupply and co-op spawn slots.

pieces.name: Ballistic cover
pieces.detail: All 28 obstacle volumes carry real vertical bounds; low barriers are no longer invisible walls.

pieces.name: Sound & feedback
pieces.detail: Layered procedural cues and ambience with bounded voices. Unlock and disposal verified; a listening review is still pending.

pieces.name: Network co-op
pieces.detail: Two-browser critic confirmed room create/join, squad deployment, peer movement, shared enemy state, shot receipts, host abort and re-deploy. Remaining: confirmed shared kills, guest damage, squad restart.

pieces.name: Interface & onboarding
pieces.detail: Separated pointer capture, larger combat labels, narrow HUD breakpoints, explicit setting values, world-anchored supply locator, and singular/plural plus ESSENCE wording fixes.

pieces.name: Progress-page reliability
pieces.detail: Validated updates keep a complete last-good snapshot, expose freshness, and announce changes to assistive technology.

reviews: Regression suite: npm test — 21/21 passing (gameplay behaviors plus real-WebSocket transport). Production build passes.

Visual critic round 1: deployment hierarchy is the strongest piece, but the field read as a clean, evenly lit demo. Required abandonment history, lighting contrast, HUD readability and non-overlapping onboarding. Fixed in this round; new captures pending.

Combat critic round 1: movement, sprint and stamina, automatic fire, recoil, reload 29 to 30, headshot kills worth 150, body damage 84 to 52, seven legitimate kills and paid resupply all confirmed working. Biggest gap: the ADS receiver obscured the target area.

Co-op critic round 1: room code, squad deployment, peer movement, shared enemy IDs and positions, shot receipts, host abort and re-deploy confirmed across two live browser contexts. Biggest gap: teammate identification, now implemented as roster plus nameplates.
Progress critic round 1: five-second polling, injected 503 recovery, keyboard navigation and 320px layout passed; missing live-region announcements and stale markers addressed.
Documentation critic round 1: POSIX-only preview script and missing Node prerequisite corrected to Node 22.12 or newer.

Evidence boundary: all browser evidence uses CPU SwiftShader, not hardware acceleration. No installed Call of Duty reference exists here, so no blind A/B or parity claim is made. Critics certify only what they directly observed.
